question: Which of the following years marked the end of the initial seven Five Year Plans that commenced in 1950?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1990**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The concept of **Five-Year Plans** in India was introduced in **1951** under the Planning Commission to achieve **economic development** and **social justice**.
 
• The **Seventh Five-Year Plan** (1985–1990) marked the conclusion of the **initial seven Five-Year Plans**, which spanned from **1951 to 1990**.
 
• The **Seventh Plan** focused on **poverty alleviation**, **employment generation**, and ensuring **self-reliance** for the Indian economy.
